title: First-Order RC Charging Circuit
description: Step charging response of a series resistor-capacitor network modeled with IBM CSMP/360 INTGRL and RKSFX fixed-step integration.
code:
* IBM System/360 CSMP First-Order RC Charging Circuit
TITLE FIRST-ORDER RC CHARGING CIRCUIT
INITIAL
  PARAM R = 1000.0, C = 0.001, VIN = 5.0
  INCON VC0 = 0.0
  TAU = R * C
DYNAMIC
SORT
  VCDOT = (VIN - VC) / TAU
  VC = INTGRL(VC0, VCDOT)
  ICURR = (VIN - VC) / R
TERMINAL
  VFINAL = VC
TIMER FINTIM = 5.0, DELT = 0.01, PRDEL = 0.5, OUTDEL = 0.5
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT VC, ICURR
END
STOP

title: Damped Harmonic Oscillator
description: Second-order linear spring-mass-damper mechanical oscillator using paired INTGRL integrators and a NOSORT energy balance calculation.
code:
* IBM System/360 CSMP Damped Harmonic Oscillator
TITLE DAMPED HARMONIC OSCILLATOR
INITIAL
  PARAM M = 1.5, C = 0.45, K = 12.0
  INCON X0 = 0.25, V0 = 0.0
  WN = SQRT(K / M)
DYNAMIC
SORT
  XDD = (-C * XD - K * X) / M
  XD = INTGRL(V0, XDD)
  X = INTGRL(X0, XD)
NOSORT
  ENERGY = 0.5 * M * XD**2 + 0.5 * K * X**2
TERMINAL
  FINAL_E = ENERGY
TIMER FINTIM = 10.0, DELT = 0.01, PRDEL = 0.5, OUTDEL = 0.5
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT X, XD, ENERGY
PRTPLT X(XD)
END
STOP

title: Relay-Controlled Spacecraft Attitude Thruster
description: Single-axis rigid spacecraft attitude control using cold-gas reaction thrusters with dead-space and hysteresis switching nonlinearities.
code:
* Single-Axis Spacecraft Attitude Control with Deadspace Relay Thrusters
TITLE SPACECRAFT ATTITUDE THRUSTER RELAY CONTROL
INITIAL
  PARAM INERTIA = 120.0, THRUST = 1.8, KRATE = 4.0, DBAND = 0.02
  INCON THETA0 = 0.35, OMEGA0 = 0.0
DYNAMIC
SORT
  ERR = -THETA - KRATE * OMEGA
  DEAD_ERR = DEADSP(-DBAND, DBAND, ERR)
  TORQUE = THRUST * LIMIT(-1.0, 1.0, DEAD_ERR * 100.0)
  ALPHA = TORQUE / INERTIA
  OMEGA = INTGRL(OMEGA0, ALPHA)
  THETA = INTGRL(THETA0, OMEGA)
  FUEL = INTGRL(0.0, ABS(TORQUE))
TERMINAL
  TOTAL_IMPULSE = FUEL
TIMER FINTIM = 40.0, DELT = 0.05, PRDEL = 2.0, OUTDEL = 2.0
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT THETA, OMEGA, TORQUE, FUEL
END
STOP

title: Nonlinear Pendulum Phase-Plane Dynamics
description: Large-angle nonlinear gravity pendulum with viscous pivot friction and external periodic torque forcing, illustrating phase-plane trajectories.
code:
* Large-Angle Forced Nonlinear Pendulum Phase-Plane Study
TITLE NONLINEAR PENDULUM PHASE-PLANE DYNAMICS
INITIAL
  CONST GRAV = 9.80665
  PARAM LENGTH = 1.2, MASS = 2.0, DAMP = 0.15, FAMP = 1.4, WDRIVE = 2.4
  INCON PHI0 = 2.1, PHID0 = 0.0
  GL = GRAV / LENGTH
DYNAMIC
SORT
  FORCING = (FAMP / (MASS * LENGTH**2)) * SIN(WDRIVE * TIME)
  PHIDD = -GL * SIN(PHI) - (DAMP / MASS) * PHID + FORCING
  PHID = INTGRL(PHID0, PHIDD)
  PHI = INTGRL(PHI0, PHID)
NOSORT
  POT_E = MASS * GRAV * LENGTH * (1.0 - COS(PHI))
  KIN_E = 0.5 * MASS * (LENGTH * PHID)**2
  TOT_E = POT_E + KIN_E
TERMINAL
  FINAL_PHI = PHI
TIMER FINTIM = 20.0, DELT = 0.01, PRDEL = 1.0, OUTDEL = 1.0
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT PHI, PHID, TOT_E
PRTPLT PHI(PHID)
END
STOP

title: Multi-Stage Hydraulic Servomechanism with AFGEN Valve Curve
description: Closed-loop electro-hydraulic position servomechanism combining a reusable MACRO spool-valve stage, AFGEN nonlinear orifice flow table, and PROCEDURE saturation clamping.
code:
* Multi-Stage Electro-Hydraulic Servomechanism with Nonlinear Valve Table
TITLE HYDRAULIC SERVOMECHANISM WITH AFGEN VALVE CURVE
FUNCTION VALVEC = (-1.0, -0.85), (-0.5, -0.55), (-0.1, -0.05), (0.0, 0.0), (0.1, 0.05), (0.5, 0.55), (1.0, 0.85)
MACRO YOUT = LAGBLK(UIN, TAU, Y0)
  YOUT = INTGRL(Y0, (UIN - YOUT) / TAU)
ENDMAC
INITIAL
  PARAM KP = 4.5, TAUV = 0.04, AREA = 0.0025, MASS = 18.0, VISC = 45.0, BETA = 1.2E9, VOL = 0.001
  PARAM XREF = 0.08, QMAX = 0.0012
  INCON X0 = 0.0, V0 = 0.0, P0 = 0.0
DYNAMIC
SORT
  POSERR = XREF - XPOS
PROCEDURE UVALVE = CLAMP(POSERR, KP)
  UVALVE = LIMIT(-1.0, 1.0, KP * POSERR)
ENDPRO
  XSPOOL = LAGBLK(UVALVE, TAUV, 0.0)
  QFLOW = QMAX * AFGEN(VALVEC, XSPOOL)
  PDOT = (BETA / VOL) * (QFLOW - AREA * VEL)
  PRESS = INTGRL(P0, PDOT)
  ACCEL = (AREA * PRESS - VISC * VEL) / MASS
  VEL = INTGRL(V0, ACCEL)
  XPOS = INTGRL(X0, VEL)
TERMINAL
  FINAL_ERR = XREF - XPOS
TIMER FINTIM = 3.0, DELT = 0.002, PRDEL = 0.2, OUTDEL = 0.2
METHOD RKSFX
PRINT XPOS, VEL, PRESS, XSPOOL
END
STOP
